title: Panda with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='22' r='14' fill='#5b4a8a'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='22' r='14' fill='#5b4a8a'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='22' r='9' fill='#8b7bb8'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='22' r='9' fill='#8b7bb8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='32' ry='30' fill='#f2f0ff'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='47' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#5b4a8a' transform='rotate(-15 37 47)'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='47' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#5b4a8a' transform='rotate(15 63 47)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='46' r='7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='46' r='7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='46' r='4.5' fill='#2e1f5e'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='46' r='4.5' fill='#2e1f5e'/>
  <!-- sparkles in eyes -->
  <circle cx='36.5' cy='44' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='44' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='48' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='48' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- star sparkles around eyes -->
  <g fill='#ffe66d'>
    <polygon points='30,32 31.5,36 36,36 32.5,38.5 34,43 30,40.5 26,43 27.5,38.5 24,36 28.5,36'/>
    <polygon points='70,32 71.5,36 76,36 72.5,38.5 74,43 70,40.5 66,43 67.5,38.5 64,36 68.5,36'/>
    <polygon points='50,25 51,28 54,28 51.5,30 52.5,33 50,31 47.5,33 48.5,30 46,28 49,28'/>
  </g>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#4a3a7a'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M44 63 Q50 68 56 63' fill='none' stroke='#6b5a9a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 62 L50 66' fill='none' stroke='#6b5a9a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='58' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#ffb3c6' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='75' cy='58' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#ffb3c6' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
